quests.title: A Taste Beyond Time

dialogue.t: Everyone's here! Has the tasting started already? Look at this crowd!
Tell me about it! Word of a collaboration between a Fontainian head chef and Liyue's culinary talents has spread like wildfire all over Yilong Wharf. How could anyone pass this up?
Here is the joint masterpiece of our food street — the Celestial Tea Crisp.
A Wangxiao Cake as big as an actual cake!

dialogue.sit: Sounds like one of your dreams has come to life, Paimon.

dialogue.t: Can this even be called a Wangxiao Cake?
It is a joint effort, after all, so we incorporated a few techniques from Fontainian pastry-making.
Besides, my friends from Liyue tell me that Wangxiao Cake is a treat meant to be enjoyed together with family during the Moonchase Festival.
Wouldn't it be more fitting, then, to craft it into a full-sized cake that can be sliced and shared?
...Let us taste it first.
From what I gathered, the main issue with Wangxiao Cakes as a dessert is that they can be overly sweet and cloying for some. That's why we focused on creating a clean, refreshing flavor.
So I designed a filling that replaces Sweet Flower nectar with one that's only mildly sweet, infusing it with Chenyu Adeptea extract.

Finally, I enlisted the help of Xiangling and Smiley Yanxiao, who crafted the pastry crusts with great precision. This allowed us to preserve the cake's signature flavor. Now, I would love to hear your impressions.
Whoa, it's so sweet and fragrant, yet incredibly refreshing... If my dango tasted this good, business at the Aisa Bathhouse would definitely pick up!
We're supposed to be on vacation, so stop thinking about work... Still, it really is delicious...
And how did you find it, sir?
Now, don't jump to conclusions just yet, sir. Alright, folks, we have one final round for today's tasting.
Please give our authentic Five-Nut Wangxiao Cakes a try! Smiley Yanxiao and I made this batch especially for you all!
Oh? Mmm...
Whoa, this is surprisingly good! Nothing like what Paimon expected!
The very first Wangxiao Cake I ever tasted as a kid was a Five-Nut Wangxiao Cake from a gift box. That taste was... hard to describe. Honestly, I still haven't forgotten it...
After becoming a chef, I never touched the stuff again. But those gift-box cakes weren't what you were looking for at all, were they?
Indeed... this flavor is what I've been longing for all along. But why...?
I said we'd make a Wangxiao Cake better than the traditional Five-Nut. But if the cake we're beating isn't even the real deal, how could that count as a victory?
Now, everyone, please judge for yourselves.
Mmm...
There is no need for further debate. This authentic Five-Nut cake is crisp and flaky, and captures the taste of my childhood perfectly... Yet even so, your Celestial Tea Crisp is still a cut above.
Yay!
Truth be told, it wasn't just the taste I missed. Five-Nut Wangxiao Cakes weren't even made like this originally. Back then, they couldn't even scrape five types of nuts together.
In those days, we just pooled whatever good ingredients we had on hand and saved the cakes to share with our families during the festival.
As living standards improved, the fillings became fancier and fancier, but the cakes ended up locked away in decorative gift boxes, never actually making it to the family table.
What I missed... was the warmth of everyone coming together to enjoy the cake.
Sir...
Our Fontainian chef just said that Wangxiao Cakes are made to be shared. Well said, I say. This is, in all likelihood, the true spirit of this tradition.
I only realized this after learning much from my friends here in Liyue. And just now, sir, you've taught me something truly valuable as well.
In that case, please bake a few more batches of these cakes for everyone to enjoy. The Guild will cover all the costs.
Yippee!
Ooh, hey there, Zibai! Are you checking out the food street too?
I was merely passing through, but seeing so many people gathered to share a pastry brought back memories... so I stopped to take a closer look.
Miss Zibai, you're here too? Would you like to try some of the Wangxiao Cakes we made?
Wangxiao Cakes...
Paimon remembers how you once mentioned something called "Fullmoon Cakes." People ate them together during festivals too! Are they related to today's Wangxiao Cakes, by any chance?
Huh. Speaking of that, my dad did say that today's Wangxiao Cakes evolved from an ancient pastry.
Permit me to have a taste first. Hmm... Mmm... Sweet without being saccharine... Rather, it is light and refreshing. Truly delicious.
And yet, its ingredients and craftsmanship are vastly different from Fullmoon Cakes. Even if it did descend from them, the two can hardly be considered the same pastry anymore.
Huh. It almost sounds like you've actually tasted those Fullmoon Cakes yourself, Miss Zibai...
Indeed, I have. I'd say that was roughly a few thousand years ago.
Um, are you playing another character, Miss Zibai?
Hehehe...
Still, this scene, with everyone gathering to share good food... That hasn't changed in the slightest, despite the passage of years.

quests.description: Just what do "authentic" Wangxiao Cakes taste like? Oddly enough, the answer to this question does not appear to lie in the cakes themselves...
